zh-CN.title: 襄阳
zh-CN.shortSummary: 襄阳是东晋佛教僧团、译经组织与长江中游交通网络的城市尺度入口。
curatorialDescription: 地图以现代城市中心作为历史区域锚点；坐标不证明道安或其他人物的每一次活动。
zh-CN.researchNote: 城址变迁、具体寺院和道安活动节点仍需接入地方志与传记的段落级来源。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 东晋佛教网络重点；历史城市锚点

en.title: Xiangyang
en.shortSummary: Xiangyang is a city-scale entry into Eastern Jin Buddhist communities, translation organisation and the middle Yangtze travel network.
curatorialDescription: The map uses the modern city centre as a historical regional anchor; the coordinate does not prove every activity of Dao'an or any other figure.
en.researchNote: City-site changes, specific monasteries and Dao'an activity nodes require paragraph-level local and biographical sources.
en.timeLabel: Eastern Jin Buddhist-network focus; historical city anchor

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 3–5 世纪的历史城市网络
displayDate.en: Historical urban network, c. third–fifth centuries

zh-CN.title: 庐山
zh-CN.shortSummary: 庐山把慧远的东林寺僧团、白鹿洞书院与跨时代宗教和教育记忆叠加在同一文化景观。
curatorialDescription: 庐山是现实山地，不是纯粹象征空间；慧远与朱熹的不同年代将在关系层明确区分。
zh-CN.researchNote: 东林寺、白鹿洞书院和山地范围需继续拆分为可引用的遗产、制度与人物节点。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 东晋至宋代持续文化景观

en.title: Mount Lu
en.shortSummary: Mount Lu layers Huiyuan's Donglin community, the White Deer Grotto Academy and cross-era religious and educational memory in one cultural landscape.
curatorialDescription: Mount Lu is a real mountain landscape rather than symbolic space; the different dates of Huiyuan and Zhu Xi remain explicit in the relation layer.
en.researchNote: Donglin, the White Deer Grotto Academy and the mountain's extent require further heritage, institutional and figure-level separation.
en.timeLabel: A continuous cultural landscape from the Eastern Jin to Song

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 386–1191 年的文化景观层

zh-CN.title: 茅山
zh-CN.shortSummary: 茅山是陶弘景隐居、道教知识生产与南朝山地宗教记忆交汇的现实文化景观。
curatorialDescription: 地图显示山地范围的近似锚点；后世宫观谱系和神仙叙事不被压缩成单一历史坐标。
zh-CN.researchNote: 茅山宫观沿革、陶弘景居止和梁代书信节点需继续按地方与文本来源分层。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 南朝至后世道教文化景观

en.title: Mount Mao
en.shortSummary: Mount Mao is a real cultural landscape where Tao Hongjing's reclusion, Daoist knowledge production and Southern Dynasties religious memory meet.
curatorialDescription: The map shows an approximate mountain anchor; later monastery genealogies and immortal narratives are not compressed into one historical coordinate.
en.researchNote: Monastery history, Tao Hongjing's residence and Liang-period correspondence require layered local and textual sources.
en.timeLabel: Southern Dynasties and later Daoist cultural landscape

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 5–10 世纪的道教文化景观
displayDate.en: Daoist cultural landscape, c. fifth–tenth centuries

zh-CN.title: 建康
zh-CN.shortSummary: 建康是南朝宫廷、佛教制度与山地宗教网络发生联系的历史城市空间。
curatorialDescription: 建康以南京历史城市中心作为空间锚点；坐标表达城市尺度，不等同于梁廷全部活动范围。
zh-CN.researchNote: 宫寺制度、都城范围与陶弘景—梁武帝关系需要继续接入正史和考古城市史资料。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 南朝都城；历史城市锚点

en.title: Jiankang
en.shortSummary: Jiankang is the historical urban setting where the Southern Dynasties court, institutional Buddhism and mountain religious networks intersected.
curatorialDescription: Jiankang uses the historic city centre of Nanjing as a spatial anchor; the coordinate is city-scale and does not cover every activity of the Liang court.
en.researchNote: Court–monastery institutions, city extent and the Tao Hongjing–Liang Wudi relation require histories and archaeological urban sources.
en.timeLabel: Southern Dynasties capital; historical city anchor

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 420–589 年的南朝城市制度层
displayDate.en: Southern Dynasties urban-institutional layer, c. 420–589 CE

zh-CN.title: 武夷山
zh-CN.shortSummary: 武夷山是朱熹讲学、书院网络与宋代理学地方化的重要山地文化景观。
curatorialDescription: 地图采用山地近似点位；朱熹的讲学与居止节点仍需按地方志和文集进一步细化。
zh-CN.researchNote: 书院、精舍和具体讲学地点需要接入可定位的地方文献与遗产资料。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 宋代以来的儒学文化景观

en.title: Wuyi Mountains
en.shortSummary: The Wuyi Mountains are a key landscape for Zhu Xi's teaching, academy networks and the local formation of Song Neo-Confucian learning.
curatorialDescription: The map uses an approximate mountain point; Zhu Xi's teaching and residence nodes require further local-gazetteer and collected-writings work.
en.researchNote: Academies, studios and specific teaching sites need locatable local and heritage documentation.
en.timeLabel: Confucian cultural landscape from the Song onward

displayDate.zh-CN: 约 12 世纪的儒学文化景观
displayDate.en: Confucian cultural landscape, c. twelfth century
